Class AsyncVirtualView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am32.controller.AsyncVirtualView
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameView, LobbyView, VirtualView, Runnable
public class AsyncVirtualView extends Object implements VirtualView, Runnable
Decorator class for the virtual view that handles outgoing messages asynchronously.
